### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/rest`, touching **17** documentable anchor(s).

**18** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de`.

⛔ **16** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sharingModel (symbol, 49 pages)`
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **66** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d6f3dc8c7ae1b9d3ef9bf9d9056d9c6d16a27b8f` — the merge of head `b36be4c714a6a163985d7d03661829a141e3cbaf` into base `4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d6f3dc8c7ae1b9d3ef9bf9d9056d9c6d16a27b8f && git checkout d6f3dc8c7ae1b9d3ef9bf9d9056d9c6d16a27b8f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de b36be4c714a6a163985d7d03661829a141e3cbaf && git checkout -B drift-repro 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de && git merge --no-ff b36be4c714a6a163985d7d03661829a141e3cbaf

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — L1 REWORK · head `a31b2c96ffd4246b527a314014811f32f3769fbc` · 2026-11-24T07:45Z

- **Shape:** open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #35399`, no other card bound. `Fixes` is right because the whole card plus all four scope notes are delivered. `mergeable_state` is clean (REST; the face read `unknown` once). l1-face: 12 ok, 1 flag (changeset: `@objectstack/rest` touched, no entry).
- **Delivery vs card:** the roster reads `resolveUserActionTransfer` through `ownerTransferOff` (`packages/core/src/security/user-assigned-work.ts:109`), gated by `isTransferEligible`. `accessFollowsMaster` is gone, so there is no second reading of the switch (route rule 1). A parity pin asserts the roster verdict equals `resolveUserActionTransfer(def).enabled` and `changeOwnerOffReason === undefined` over 9 defs. The Done-when pins all exist: switch on (bare and object form), switch off (both), derived default on a detail, app-authored `owner_id` (`systemFields: false`) and approver untouched. The #35344 interim pin is subsumed, with a note. Scope note 1: counted-not-moved with `reason: 'transfer_off'`, the panel picks its sentence by reason, and `remaining` counts only transferable rows. Scope note 2: the optional master follows the switch, pinned with a null-master row; N2 prose rewritten in client and rest-server; N3 has its own key in 11 locales. Scope note 3 (7007096169): the docblock lead sentence is now per object ("usually … An author whose detail has a real owner … turns the switch on"). Scope note N4 (7069035638): a dogfood case through Change Owner (`assertAssignableUser` at `change-record-owner.ts:362`). It is armed (`GET /data/sys_user/:id` returns 404), asserts status, `code` and `fields`, checks message parity with a missing id, and preserves the owner.
- **Gates:** check-runs at the head show 61 success, 9 skipped (all expected), 0 failed, 0 pending. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both success.
- **Tests evidence:** real counts are cited: core 156/156 files (3740 tests), client 59/59, rest user-work-routes 7/7, dogfood change-owner 7/7, banAssignedWork 16/16, i18n 108 files / 2011 tests. The app-shell narrowing is declared; CI's Test UI 16/16 is green. The dogfood shards are skipped on the PR (they run in the queue), so the N4 case is evidenced locally only. Both refusal halves are pinned (off means counted and never read or written by owner; on means moved), as is preservation (app fields, null-master row). The SQL push-down holds: kept rows use the same `engine.count`, and transfer filters `refs` before any query.
- **Sentence reads:** I read every sentence of the changeset, `data-api.mdx` (+4/-2) and `administrator-guide.mdx` (+23/-15) against the diff, and all match the code apart from the N1 and N2 nits. i18n: 11 keys, all inside `console.assignedWork`. Every parenthetical matches that locale's existing `changeOwner` label. zh-Hant is consistent with generated output (对象→物件). The de pin moves 134→135 with a note.
- **Findings:**
  - **B1** `.changeset/35399-handover-follows-transfer-switch.md:1-6`: `@objectstack/rest` (published, not private, not in the `fixed` group) is touched at `rest-server.ts:6541` with no changeset entry. Under the checklist, size is not the test, and a missing entry means it cannot be queued. Fix: add `'@objectstack/rest': minor` (kind `semantic` means minor, AGENTS.md Post-Task §3).
  - **S1** (follow-up card, not this PR): `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:4362` `.describe` and `user-action-transfer.ts:55` still say the switch gates only the Change Owner action. Under `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, the authorable key's published meaning has widened to the hand-over. A fix touches `packages/spec` plus gen, which is the schema face, so the seat should file a card rather than fold it in.
  - **N1** changeset:13 says "(`GET` / `POST …`) moves": GET only counts.
  - **N2** changeset:21 and :23: "Before … read 'Lists several people', which is false for an owner": no owner row ever showed that before (detail owners were left out). "still gates only these two actions": it used to gate one.
- **Skills-docs:** `none` holds. A `git grep` over `skills/` at the head finds no `userActions.transfer`, Change Owner or hand-over teaching, only list-view and interface `userActions` and the `controlled_by_parent` access rules. No follow-up is needed.
- **L2 face:** `record-recognisers --template --paths` gives no Scope hits (paths decide no face). `Clause-②: no` with no `(narrowing)` arm means the declaration face does not apply either, so no contract review is owed (Governed Surface Queue Guard: success).
- **Out of scope:** declared and justified: `core/security/index.ts` (type export), the two docs pages (made false by this change), and the de quote pin (under `ui/packages/i18n/**`). The open questions on the nested `security.sharingModel` (rec A, leave) and the spec prose (see S1) go to the seat to route.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [45373444137](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45373444137) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），

  ```
    ↳ 失败原因: AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

## Queue ejection — diagnosis · 2026-11-24T11:30Z · head `b36be4c714a6a163985d7d03661829a141e3cbaf`

Follows 7129232292. Verdict: a timing flake in the test, not this PR and not a main regression.
- Merged tree (main `49c6bf3d51` + this head): the failing file alone 10/10 green; under CPU load 10/10 green; the full shard 7/16 as CI runs it green (445 files, 5247 tests). origin/main alone: 10/10 green.
- Mechanism: the test's `flushReplay()` `setTimeout(0)` can be set before the hook's replay timer when React's passive-effect flush is delayed on a starved runner; details on the new card.
- This PR reaches the test's import closure only through one added i18n string per locale; nothing under `console/ai/`.

Not re-queued on this reading alone: by the queue rules a product-behaviour assertion in a closure the diff touches is not a re-queue case. The test is fixed on its own card, #36967 (filed, triage asked); this PR re-queues once that fix lands, or on triage's or the maintainer's word if sooner.
